name: Pacevera
description: Turns the training evidence you already have into a decision about today's session.
long_description: Ask your assistant whether today's planned session still makes sense, and Pacevera answers from your own recent training and whatever recovery readings you have: keep the session, ease it, swap a movement, or move it — with the reading and the rule behind the answer. It is a deterministic fitness decision engine. Local/private continuity may store a hashed-identity athlete record on infrastructure you control until you delete it; hosted remote is no-go and, when eventually enabled, must remain transient and stateless. Pacevera calls no AI model of its own. A reading nobody gave it is reported as missing rather than guessed at, and the confidence it reports drops to match.

private_data_dir.title: Your exported health data folder
private_data_dir.description: Optional. Pick a folder holding Apple Health / Garmin / Strava / Google Health exports (subfolders export_apple_health, export_garmin/DI_CONNECT, export_strava, export_google_health/raw) and assess_fitness_state / decide_session / generate_plan / generate_workout will read it automatically whenever you don't type your own numbers. Nothing here is read unless you select a folder; you can still just describe your training in words instead.

tools.name: assess_fitness_state
tools.description: Read today's recovery and training state from submitted evidence, or from your local export folder when you don't supply any. Reports state only; never says what to train.

tools.name: decide_session
tools.description: Decide what today's scheduled session should become — keep it, ease it, or change it — with the evidence behind the change. Reads your local export folder when you don't supply evidence yourself.

tools.name: decide_exercise_substitution
tools.description: Decide what to do instead of a movement the user cannot do today, with anything their injuries rule out filtered out first.

tools.name: generate_plan
tools.description: Build a training plan when the user has no plan in hand. Reads your local export folder when you don't supply evidence yourself.

tools.name: preview_adjust_plan
tools.description: Show what adjusting an existing plan would change, without applying it.

tools.name: commit_adjust_plan
tools.description: Compute the plan a previewed adjustment produces, once the user has accepted the preview. Your assistant keeps the result; this extension stores nothing.

tools.name: get_evidence_coverage
tools.description: Report which recovery and training signals are present or missing.

tools.name: explain_decision
tools.description: Return the bounded rule and source trace for a decision from this process.

tools.name: submit_outcome
tools.description: Normalize an observed result for a prior case; durable outcome storage remains caller-controlled.

tools.name: generate_workout
tools.description: Generate one picker-sized workout and adapt it through the decision engine. Reads your local export folder when you don't supply evidence yourself.

tools.name: evidra_local_decide_today
tools.description: Decide what today's already-scheduled local plan should become, read from this machine's local SQLite store. No hosted MCP or provider token is involved.

tools.name: evidra_preview_today
tools.description: MANDATORY FIRST STEP for today's workout, readiness, recovery, sleep, recent exercise, or whether to follow/change a scheduled session. Read the selected local health export folder before answering; do not answer from memory alone or call decide_session first.
